title: [Let's Do] Herbal Brews Various Teas by Shearing Flowers
description: Flowers drop [Let's Do] Herbal Brews tea leaves when broken with shears.
body:
This datapack modifies [Let’s Do] Herbal Brews so that vanilla flowers drop various types of tea when harvested with shears.

It’s designed to make obtaining tea easier and more intuitive.

1.20.1 version is untested - let me know if it works!

**Will not play nice with other mods that change vanilla flower drops.**

**Requirements:**
Neoforge for Minecraft 1.21.1
[[Let's Do] Herbal Brews](https://modrinth.com/mod/lets-do-herbalbrews)

Flower 		-> 	    Tea
Allium			    Yerba Mate
Azure Bluet		    Lavender Blossom
Blue Orchid		    Lavender Blossom
Cornflower		    Lavender Blossom
Dandelion		    Rooibos
Lilac**			    Lavender Blossom
Lily of the Valley	Green Tea Leaf
Orange Tulip		Green Tea Leaf
Oxeye Daisy		    Rooibos
Peony			    Hibiscus
Pink Tulip		    Green Tea Leaf
Poppy			    Hibiscus
Red Tulip		    Green Tea Leaf
Rose Bush*		    Hibiscus
Sunflower		    Rooibos
Sweet Berry Bush*	Yerba Mate
Torchflower		    Coffee Beans
White Tulip		    Green Tea Leaf

*not working
**working, but not as intended
